description: This file is a Python source code for benchmarking and managing models from the 'timm' library, including model loading, configuration, and execution logic.

classes.name: TimmRunner
classes.description: A benchmarking class for managing and executing 'timm' models, including loading models, handling configurations, and running benchmarks.

methods.name: refresh_model_names
methods.description: Function to refresh and update the list of model names from documentation and the 'timm' library.

methods.name: load_model
methods.description: Loads a specified 'timm' model onto a device with given configurations, preparing inputs and setting evaluation or training mode.

methods.name: iter_model_names
methods.description: Generator yielding model names based on filtering criteria for benchmarking.

methods.name: pick_grad
methods.description: Returns gradient context manager based on whether training or inference.

methods.name: use_larger_multiplier_for_smaller_tensor
methods.description: Determines if a larger multiplier should be used for smaller tensors based on model name.

methods.name: get_tolerance_and_cosine_flag
methods.description: Calculates numerical tolerance and cosine similarity flag based on model name and mode.

methods.name: compute_loss
methods.description: Computes scalar loss from model predictions.

methods.name: scaled_compute_loss
methods.description: Computes scaled scalar loss for specific models.

methods.name: forward_pass
methods.description: Performs a forward pass through a model with autocasting.

methods.name: forward_and_backward_pass
methods.description: Performs a forward and backward pass, including gradient scaling and optimizer steps.
